groups.name: Semester 1 (First Year)
groups.rule: Other options exist to meet this requirement. Mathematics - if a student takes the four (4) credit hour mathematics course; three (3) of those hours will apply towards the mathematics requirement. The remaining one (1) credit hour from that mathematics course will be applied to the general elective requirement and does not count towards the 42-hour Core.

groups.name: Semester 2 (First Year Continued)
groups.rule: Other options exist to meet this requirement. Speak with your success coach about elective options.
